text:
Ivy: Quick proposal  run a micro experiment next week: free credits + two prompt packs + a tiny webinar. Hypothesis: credits+templates push signup->3queries within 48h by ~10%.

Noah: Nice. Cohort size?

Ivy: 450 seeded signups, split A/B. A gets webinar + credits + templates; B gets credits + templates only. Keep numbers even.

Ben: Templates we'll surface: 'hackathon-kit' and 'outreach-snippets'. Short social: `Claim 100 free credits + prompt pack. Join our 30-min workshop.`

Zoe: Routing note: use utm and set signup meta `seed_cohort`. Seeded users skip product tour, land on templates modal with "Run sample" CTA. Enqueue 24h email nudge and 48h in-app push.

Noah: Analytics: baseline conversion ~19%. With the bundle expect ~27% (directional). I'll add cohort dashboards for activation funnel and 7d retention.

Ivy: Timing: assets + landing Mon EOD, routing live Tue 9AM PT, influencer posts Tue 10AM PT, webinar Wed 4PM PT. Need gating: email verify before claim.

Ben: Prompt snippets (examples):
```
// hackathon-kit
1) "Generate a prompt chain to summarize meeting audio into tasks."
// outreach-snippets
1) "Shorten this outreach to 3 lines for Head of Ops, include metric-driven hook."
```

Zoe: A/B variant detail: within A optionally test a small credit-size split (100 vs 200) on a tiny subsample (n~50) to check sensitivity. Ops: if spam spikes, pause issuance and whitelist influencers.

Ivy: Action items: Ben (assets + prompt packs), Noah (dashboards + utm tracking), Zoe (routing + gating), deploy-bot schedule event. Check-in Tue 10AM PT. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Created calendar event "Micro-credit activation workshop" Wed 16:00 PT  invite sent to #marketing.

Noah: I'll share the analytics link once wired.

Ben: I'll upload social + hero assets to drive and post link here.

Ivy: Perfect. Keep the variants focused so we can attribute the webinar effect clearly.
